observed_selected_catalog_entry.title: Treiber push/pop, protected lifetime and bounded reuse

environment.language: ISO C17 baseline; C11 draft source comparison accurately labeled
environment.target: Linux native pthreads and finite GenMC RC11; strict M4 object/link audit separately
environment.dependencies: Core uses C atomics and caller storage only; no allocator/container/lock/thread library. Pthreads/GenMC/Python are host verification tools.

passages: Peekable Treiber stack: Node/top, complete push and pop CAS loops
Section2.3 ABA and live-node reinsertion, printed493
Sections3.1-3.4 scan, continuous protection and safety argument, printed493-496
7.17.3 paragraphs1–7 and12: orders, SC total order, RMW predecessor

limitations: Finite author RC11/native runs are not arbitrary-history proof, physical timing or independent learner assessment.
Original IBM1986 and exact published C17/C23 remain access gaps; bounded index stack is an explicit adaptation.

rubric.criterion: Implement actual single-head Treiber push/pop with protected revalidation, immutable published links and precise LIFO linearization.

levels.0: Violates publication, lifetime, identity or evidence contract.
levels.1: Reproduces ordinary LIFO fixture without concurrent invariants.
levels.2: Implement actual single-head Treiber push/pop with protected revalidation, immutable published links and precise LIFO linearization. Supply the causal counterexample and changed-condition proof.
levels.3: Independently reconstruct after at least7days under changed contention/reuse assumptions.
